title: 船舶熱回收系統
summary: 從熱源溫位和流量到用熱需求建立可回收熱量帳，避免只以排氣高溫估效益。 在船舶餘熱與熱交換數位室依十個單元完成機制觀察、定量比較、量測驗證與故障診斷；各算例為獨立教學假設，完整保留資料來源與模型限制。
summaryEn: Build recoverable-heat balances from source temperature/flow and heat demand rather than exhaust temperature alone. Complete ten units of mechanisms, quantitative comparisons, measurement verification and diagnosis in the Ship waste-heat/exchanger digital laboratory. Examples are independent teaching assumptions with sources and model limitations retained.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的原創船舶海洋教學。數值均為明示假設，不是同名船舶的實測規格、法規認證或實船操作參數。以虛構資料、教學模型與常壓桌面練習學習，排除武器、戰術與載人下潛操作。
scopeEn: Original marine teaching based on public principles. All numbers are explicit assumptions, not measured named-vessel specifications, certification criteria or real-ship operating parameters. Learning uses synthetic data, teaching models and unpressurized desktop exercises, excluding weapons, tactics and crewed diving operations.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 燃料能量與餘熱邊界：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Fuel energy and waste-heat boundary: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 燃料能量與餘熱邊界 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Fuel energy and waste-heat boundary and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 在「船舶熱回收系統」的「燃料能量與餘熱邊界」中，燃料質量率需由輸出功率除效率與低位熱值。 本單元須將作用機制畫成有輸入、輸出與邊界的圖，並核對是否符合本課問題：從熱源溫位和流量到用熱需求建立可回收熱量帳，避免只以排氣高溫估效益。
steps.instructionEn: Within Ship waste-heat recovery, Fuel energy and waste-heat boundary examines this mechanism: Fuel mass rate follows output power divided by efficiency and lower heating value. Draw inputs, outputs and boundaries, then relate it to the course question: Build recoverable-heat balances from source temperature/flow and heat demand rather than exhaust temperature alone.
steps.observation: 本單元為獨立假想教學台架，不可將不同單元數值拼成真實船舶規格。輸入：P=500 kW，η=0.42，LHV=42 MJ/kg。關係式 ṁ=P/(ηLHV)；含單位換算算式 500*3600/(0.42*42000) = 102.040816 kg/h。適用條件：單一燃料等效能量帳，不是雙燃料切換或供氣操作。
steps.observationEn: This unit is an independent hypothetical teaching bench; values from different units must not be combined into vessel specifications. Inputs: Output 500 kW, efficiency 0.42 and LHV 42 MJ/kg. Relation ṁ=P/(ηLHV); expression including unit conversion 500*3600/(0.42*42000) = 102.040816 kg/h. Applicability: Single-fuel equivalent energy balance, not fuel-switching or gas-supply operation.
steps.failure: 本單元先檢查以下替代原因：把燃料體積比例當能量比例會造成偏差。 比較它和輸入真正變動時會出現的觀察差別。
steps.failureEn: First examine this alternative cause: Treating fuel volume fraction as energy fraction creates bias. Compare its observable pattern with a genuine change in the input.
steps.check: 對「燃料能量與餘熱邊界」，對每種燃料分列質量與熱值，再按能量相加。 保存原始觀察和推導，不以師傅輔助完成標記代替證據。
steps.checkEn: For Fuel energy and waste-heat boundary, List mass and LHV separately for each fuel and sum their energies. Retain raw observations and derivation; an assisted-completion marker does not replace evidence.

knowledge.text: 在「燃料能量與餘熱邊界」比較基準算式 500*3600/(0.42*42000) 與替代算式 500*3600/(0.38*42000)。先圈出唯一變動的輸入並預測增減，再計算 112.781955 kg/h，與基準 102.040816 kg/h 比較。保存輸入、單位、兩個輸出與一項不能外推的結論；只在數位模型或紙上進行。

Identify the single changed input and predict direction before calculating 112.781955 kg/h, versus baseline 102.040816 kg/h. Save inputs, units, both outputs and one conclusion that cannot be extrapolated; use only digital models or paper.

For Shaft-output and heat-loss allocation, Label input/output at each energy-flow stage and avoid double-counting losses. Retain raw observations and derivation; an assisted-completion marker does not replace evidence.
